subHeading: How and Why We Use Information
text:
We use information to create and secure accounts; authenticate sessions; run games, social features, the shop, rewards, and customisation; deliver requested products; provide support; enforce rules and moderate content; prevent fraud and abuse; diagnose faults; measure and improve the Service; communicate service and security information; and meet legal obligations.

Depending on the context, our legal bases are:
  • Contract: to provide the Service or take steps you request before entering a contract.
  • Legitimate interests: to secure, operate, troubleshoot, understand, improve, and moderate the Service, provided those interests are not overridden by your rights.
  • Consent: for optional analytics storage and where we specifically ask for consent. You may withdraw consent for future use at any time.
  • Legal obligation: where we must retain, use, or disclose information to comply with law.

Providing account details is optional if you only use features available to guests, but account-only features cannot work without the required information. We do not use solely automated decisions that produce legal or similarly significant effects.

We do not sell personal information. We may share it:
  • With other users when you use public profiles, posts, parties, chat, friends, leaderboards, or similar interactive features.
  • With service providers that supply hosting, databases, email delivery, analytics, security, storage, customer support, or payment/order services, under appropriate contractual restrictions.
  • With professional advisers, regulators, law enforcement, courts, or other parties where reasonably necessary to protect rights and safety, investigate misuse, handle a dispute, or comply with law.
  • As part of a business sale, merger, financing, reorganisation, or transfer, subject to appropriate safeguards.

Some providers, including Google Analytics, may process information outside the United Kingdom. Where required, we use an applicable adequacy decision or contractual safeguards for international transfers. Provider-specific terms and privacy notices also apply to their processing.

We keep information only for as long as reasonably needed for the purposes described above. The period depends on the feature, whether your account remains active, safety and fraud risks, backup cycles, disputes, and legal, tax, accounting, or enforcement requirements. Short-lived session and verification data expire or are replaced as part of normal operation; account, transaction, moderation, and support records may need to be kept longer. When information is no longer required, we delete or anonymise it.

We use reasonable technical and organisational safeguards, including hashed passwords and restricted access to sensitive fields. No online system is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

Depending on the law that applies to you, you may ask for access to or a copy of your personal information; correction; deletion; restriction; portability; or an objection to certain uses. You may also withdraw consent without affecting earlier lawful processing. Account privacy controls let you manage profile visibility, game-stat visibility, online status, and friend requests.

To make a request, email support@overexposed.app. We may need to verify your identity. You may also complain to your local data-protection authority; in the UK, this is the Information Commissioner’s Office at ico.org.uk.

The Service uses cookies, local storage, and similar technologies.
  • Strictly necessary storage supports account sessions, security, protected pages, guest party access, and features you request. These technologies are required for those parts of the Service to work.
  • Preference storage remembers choices such as cookie consent, account/profile cache, game settings, selected packs, sound, and text-to-speech preferences.
  • With your consent, Google Analytics measures visits and interactions, such as pages viewed, approximate location, device/browser information, and engagement, so we can understand and improve the Service. Google may set or access analytics identifiers and process data under its own terms.

You can accept or decline optional analytics through the cookie banner and can clear stored data using your browser controls. Declining analytics does not prevent essential features from using strictly necessary storage. Blocking or deleting necessary cookies or local storage may sign you out, reset preferences, or stop some features working. Learn more in Google’s explanation of data use on partner sites.

You must be at least 13 to use the Service. If the law where you live requires parental or guardian permission for an online service, you may use it only with that permission. The Service is not directed to children under 13, and we ask them not to create an account or provide personal information.

Some packs and user-generated content contain mature or NSFW material intended only for adults. You must be at least 18, and old enough under local law, to access adult content. Hosts and users are responsible for selecting suitable content and respecting the comfort, safety, and age of everyone present.

The Service is provided for entertainment. Participation in any prompt, dare, conversation, or activity is voluntary; skip anything unsafe, illegal, or uncomfortable. Never use the Service as a substitute for professional medical, legal, financial, or safety advice.

To the fullest extent permitted by law, the Service is provided “as is” and “as available”. We do not promise uninterrupted or error-free operation or that user-provided content is accurate.
